messages.subject: rollout coordination vs focus Wednesdays - collision
messages.body:
Heads-up before I build the rollout schedule:

Quick recap of the problem:
1. Phased rollout runs Wed May 13 (20%) to Wed May 27 (100%)
2. During rollout weeks we need daily syncs, including Wednesdays, to catch issues from that morning's cohort fast
3. Focus Wednesdays (the no-meeting trial from February) blocks exactly those syncs

Options as I see them:
- move daily syncs to Thursday-Friday only (slow feedback during the riskiest weeks), or
- pause focus Wednesdays until the rollout is done

I lean towards the second but it is Marta's call since it touches a company-wide arrangement. I know Greg and Aisha will have views on timing too.

Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: RE: rollout coordination vs focus Wednesdays - collision
messages.body:
Hi team 😊

Just to add my two cents: support volume spiked noticeably on the first rollout Wednesday, and having the whole company unreachable for internal coordination for a day made the escalation path slower than I would have liked. I don't have strong feelings about the policy itself - it's been lovely for the team, honestly - but for these three weeks I'd rather we can all reach each other.

Warmly,
Aisha
